_note: Named clinical attestations. A first-class provenance type: an operative rule asserted by a named clinician, with who/when/role/rationale per the append-only ledger discipline. Graded as attested practice, not literature. Attached to tickets by subject match.

attestations.subject: nitrofurantoin
attestations.claim: Nitrofurantoin is contraindicated at creatinine clearance or eGFR below 60 mL/min/1.73m2
attestations.literature_note: Efficacy basis supported (ten Doesschate 2020; Sharma 2023). Safety basis contested (Oplinger 2013; Ahmed 2018). Attestation settles the operative rule; the split stays recorded.
